additional_concerns: Exposure definitions and instrument examples are delegated to the supplied aggregate-exposure fact. The formula does not verify look-through, valuation, aggregation or avoidance of double counting; this is an implementation boundary, not evidence that the threshold is wrong.
The circular supplies no complete exposure measurement methodology. If operational measurement requires additional SFC guidance, that authority and its dependency mapping must be supplied.

The conflict-blocking runtime policy is an evidentiary restriction, not a classification condition stated by the circular. It can block evaluation even when an independently established classification route is true.

The representation adds no classification grace period, direct-exposure-only restriction or exemption for existing authorised funds. Footnote 1's 15% direct-investment limit is not an alternative complex-product threshold.

FALSE must retain the question's narrow meaning: neither circular trigger is established as operative on the assessed facts. OUT_OF_SCOPE, UNKNOWN and CONFLICT do not establish general non-complex status.
The supplied external dependency IDs have no identifying metadata or source hashes. No reliable mapping to particular incorporated authorities can be made.
